notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
--script banner reads raw service banner immediately after connection. --script smtp-commands issues EHLO and reads the server's full SMTP capability list. Combined: fingerprints the SMTP server version + supported extensions in one scan.

=== BANNER DETAIL ===
banner script captures what version detection normalizes: '220 inlane ESMTP Postfix (Ubuntu)' includes OS distribution. smtp-commands reveals: VRFY (user enum viable), STARTTLS, AUTH methods, supported ESMTP extensions.

=== CHAINING ===
SMTP service discovered → banner + smtp-commands → if VRFY listed: attempt user enumeration → discovered usernames → IMAP password spray.
